1.t: ˹The time of˺ people’s judgment has drawn near, yet they are heedlessly turning away
1.tr: Iqtaraba linnaasi hisaabuhum Wa-hum fee ghaflatim mu'ridoon

2.t: Whatever new reminder comes to them from their Lord, they only listen to it jokingly
2.tr: Maa ya'teehim min zikrim mir Rabbihim muhdasin illas tama'oohu Wa-hum yal'aboon

3.t: with their hearts ˹totally˺ distracted. The evildoers would converse secretly, ˹saying,˺ “Is this ˹one˺ not human like yourselves? Would you fall for ˹this˺ witchcraft, even though you can ˹clearly˺ see?”
3.tr: Laahiyatan quloobuhum; Wa-asarrun najwal lazeena zalamoo hal haazaaa illaa basharum mislukum 'afa-ta'toonas sihra Wa-antum tubsiroon

4.t: The Prophet responded, “My Lord ˹fully˺ knows every word spoken in the heavens and the earth. For He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.”
4.tr: Qaala Rabbee ya'lamul qawla fis samaaa'i wal-ardi Wa-Huwas Samee'ul 'Aleem

5.t: Yet they say, “This ˹Quran˺ is a set of confused dreams! No, he has fabricated it! No, he must be a poet! So let him bring us a ˹tangible˺ sign like those ˹prophets˺ sent before.”
5.tr: Bal qaalooo adghaasu ahlaamin bal iftaraahu bal huwa shaa'irun fal-ya'tinaa bi-Aayatin kamaa ursilal awwaloon

6.t: Not a ˹single˺ society We destroyed before them ever believed ˹after receiving the signs˺. Will these ˹pagans˺ then believe
6.tr: Maaa aaamanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknaahaa a-fahum yu'minoon

7.t: We did not send ˹messengers˺ before you ˹O Prophet˺ except mere men inspired by Us. If you ˹polytheists˺ do not know ˹this already˺, then ask those who have knowledge ˹of the Scriptures˺
7.tr: Wa-maaa arsalnaa qablaka illaa rijaalan nooheee ilaihim fas'aloo ahlaz zikri in kuntum laa ta'lamoon

8.t: We did not give those messengers ˹supernatural˺ bodies that did not need food, nor were they immortal
8.tr: Wa-maa ja'alnaahum jasadal laa ya'kuloonat ta'aama Wa-maa kaanoo khaalideen

9.t: Then We fulfilled Our promise to them, saving them along with whoever We willed and destroying the transgressors
9.tr: Summa sadaqnaa-humul wa'da fa-anjainaahum Wa-man nashaaa'u Wa-ahlaknal musrifeen

10.t: We have surely revealed to you a Book, in which there is glory for you. Will you not then understand
10.tr: Laqad anzalnaaa ilaikum Kitaaban feehi zikrukum afalaa ta'qiloon

11.t: ˹Imagine˺ how many societies of wrongdoers We have destroyed, raising up other people after them
11.tr: Wa-kam qasamnaa min qaryatin kaanat zaalimatanw Wa-ansha'-naa ba'dahaa qawman aakhareen

12.t: When the wrongdoers sensed ˹the arrival of˺ Our torment, they started to run away from their cities
12.tr: Falammaaa ahassoo ba'sanaaa izaa hum minhaa yarkudoon

13.t: ˹They were told,˺ “Do not run away! Return to your luxuries and your homes, so you may be questioned ˹about your fate˺.”
13.tr: Laa tarkudoo warji'ooo ilaa maaa utriftum feehi Wa-masaakinikum la'allakum tus'aloon

14.t: They cried, “Woe to us! We have surely been wrongdoers.”

15.t: They kept repeating their cry until We mowed them down, ˹leaving them˺ lifeless
15.tr: Famaa zaalat tilka da'waahum hattaa ja'alnaahum haseedan khaamideen

16.t: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything in between for sport
16.tr: Wa-maa khalaqnas samaaa'a wal-arda Wa-maa bainahumaa laa'ibeen

17.t: Had We intended to take ˹some˺ amusement, We could have found it in Our presence, if that had been Our Will
17.tr: Law aradnaaa an nattakhiza lahwal lat-takhaznaahu mil ladunnaaa in kunnaa faa'ileen

18.t: In fact, We hurl the truth against falsehood, leaving it crushed, and it quickly vanishes. And woe be to you for what you claim
18.tr: Bal naqzifu bilhaqqi 'alal baatili fa-yadmaghuhoo fa-izaa huwa zaahiq; Wa-lakumul wailu mimmaa tasifoon

19.t: To Him belong all those in the heavens and the earth. And those nearest to Him are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they tire
19.tr: Wa-lahoo man fis samaawaati wal-ard; Wa-man 'indahoo laa yastakbiroona 'an 'ibaada-tihee Wa-laa yastahsiroon

20.t: They glorify ˹Him˺ day and night, never wavering

21.t: Or have they taken gods from the earth, who can raise the dead
21.tr: Amit takhazooo aalihatam minal ardi hum yunshiroon

22.t: Had there been other gods besides Allah in the heavens or the earth, both ˹realms˺ would have surely been corrupted. So Glorified is Allah, Lord of the Throne, far above what they claim
22.tr: Law kaana feehimaaa aalihatun illal laahu lafasadataa; fa-Subhaanal laahi Rabbil 'Arshi 'ammaa yasifoon

23.t: He cannot be questioned about what He does, but they will ˹all˺ be questioned

24.t: Or have they taken other gods besides Him? Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Show ˹me˺ your proof. Here is ˹the Quran,˺ the Reminder for those with me; along with ˹earlier Scriptures,˺ the Reminder for those before me.” But most of them do not know the truth, so they turn away
24.tr: Amit takhazoo min doonihee aalihatan qul haatoo burhaanakum haaza zikru mam ma'iya Wa-zikru man qablee; bal aksaruhum laa ya'lamoonal haqqa fahum mu'ridoon

25.t: We never sent a messenger before you ˹O Prophet˺ without revealing to him: “There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Me, so worship Me ˹alone˺.”
25.tr: Wa-maaa arsalnaa min qablika mir Rasoolin illaa nooheee ilaihi annahoo laaa ilaaha illaaa Ana fa'budoon

26.t: And they say, “The Most Compassionate has offspring!” Glory be to Him! In fact, those ˹angels˺ are only ˹His˺ honoured servants
26.tr: Wa-qaalut takhazar Rahmaanu waladaa; Subhaanahu bal 'ibaadum mukramoon

27.t: who do not speak until He has spoken, ˹only˺ acting at His command
27.tr: Laa yasbiqoonahoo bil-qawli Wa-hum bi-amrihee ya'maloon

28.t: He ˹fully˺ knows what is ahead of them and what is behind them. They do not intercede except for whom He approves, and they tremble in awe of Him
28.tr: Ya'lamu maa baina aideehim Wa-maa khalfahum Wa-laa yashfa'oona illaa limanir tadaa Wa-hum min khash-yatihee mushfiqoon

29.t: Whoever of them were to say, “I am a god besides Him,” they would be rewarded with Hell by Us. This is how We reward the wrongdoers
29.tr: Wa-main yaqul minhum inneee ilaahum min doonihee fazaalika najzeehi Jahannam; kazaalika najziz zaalimeen

30.t: Do the disbelievers not realize that the heavens and earth were ˹once˺ one mass then We split them apart? And We created from water every living thing. Will they not then believe
30.tr: Awalam yaral lazeena kafarooo annas samaawaati wal-arda kaanataa ratqan fafataqnaa-humaa Wa-ja'alnaa minal maaa'i kulla shai'in haiyin afalaa yu'minoon

31.t: And We have placed firm mountains upon the earth so it does not shake with them, and made in it broad pathways so they may find their way
31.tr: Wa-ja'alnaa fil ardi rawaasiya an tameeda bihim Wa-ja'alnaa feehaa fijaajan subulal la'allahum yahtadoon

32.t: And We have made the sky a well-protected canopy, still they turn away from its signs
32.tr: Wa-ja'alnas samaaa'a saqfam mahfoozanw Wa-hum 'an Aayaatihaa mu'ridoon

33.t: And He is the One Who created the day and the night, the sun and the moon—each travelling in an orbit
33.tr: Wa-Huwal lazee khalaqal laila wannahaara washshamsa wal-qamara kullun fee falakiny yasbahoon

34.t: We have not granted immortality to any human before you ˹O Prophet˺: so if you die, will they live forever
34.tr: Wa-maa ja'alnaa libasharim min qablikal khuld; afa immitta fahumul khaalidoon

35.t: Every soul will taste death. And We test you ˹O humanity˺ with good and evil as a trial, then to Us you will ˹all˺ be returned
35.tr: Kullu nafsin zaaa'iqatul mawt; Wa-nablookum bi-sharri walkhairi fitnatanw Wa-ilainaa turja'oon

36.t: When the disbelievers see you ˹O Prophet˺, they only make fun of you, ˹saying,˺ “Is this the one who speaks ˹ill˺ of your gods?” while they disbelieve at the mention of the Most Compassionate
36.tr: Wa-izaa ra-aakal lazeena kafarooo ien yattakhizoonaka illa huzuwan; ahaazal lazee yazkuru aalihatakum Wa-hum bi-zikrir Rahmaani hum kaafiroon

37.t: Humankind is made of haste. I will soon show you My signs, so do not ask Me to hasten them
37.tr: Khuliqal insaanu min 'ajal; sa-ureekum Aayaatee falaa tasta'jiloon

38.t: They ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass if what you say is true?”
38.tr: Wa-yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen

39.t: If only the disbelievers knew that a time will come when they will not be able to keep the Fire off their faces or backs, nor will they be helped
39.tr: Law ya'lamul lazeena kafaroo heena laa yakuffoona 'anw wujoohihimun Naara Wa-laa 'an zuhoorihim Wa-laa hum yunsaroon

40.t: In fact, the Hour will take them by surprise, leaving them stunned. So they will not be able to avert it, nor will it be delayed from them
40.tr: Bal ta'teehim baghtatan fatabhatuhum falaa yastatee'oona raddahaa Wa-laa hum yunzaroon

41.t: ˹Other˺ messengers had already been ridiculed before you ˹O Prophet˺, but those who mocked them were overtaken by what they used to ridicule
41.tr: Wa-laqadis tuhzi'a bi-Rusulim min qablika fahaaqa billazeena sakhiroo minhum maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon

42.t: Ask ˹them, O Prophet,˺ “Who can defend you by day or by night against the Most Compassionate?” Still they turn away from the remembrance of their Lord
42.tr: Qul main yakla-'ukum billaili wannahaari minar Rahmaan; bal hum 'an zikri Rabbihim mu'ridoon

43.t: Or do they have gods—other than Us—that can protect them? They cannot ˹even˺ protect themselves, nor will they be aided against Us
43.tr: Am lahum aalihatun tamna'uhum min dooninaa; laa yastatee'oona nasra anfusihim Wa-laa hum minna yus-haboon

44.t: In fact, We have allowed enjoyment for these ˹Meccans˺ and their forefathers for such a long time ˹that they took it for granted˺. Do they not see that We gradually reduce ˹their˺ land from its borders? Is it they who will then prevail
44.tr: Bal matta'naa haaa'ulaaa'i Wa-aabaaa'ahum hattaa taala 'alaihimul 'umur; afalaa yarawna anna na'til arda nanqusuhaa min atraafihaa; afahumul ghaaliboon

45.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I warn you only by revelation.” But the deaf cannot hear the call when they are warned
45.tr: Qul innamaaa unzirukum bilwahyi; Wa-laa yasma'us summud du'aaa-'a izaa maa yunzaroon

46.t: If they were touched by even a breath of your Lord’s torment, they would certainly cry, “Woe to us! We have really been wrongdoers.”
46.tr: Wa-la'in massat-hum nafhatun min 'azaabi Rabbika la-yaqoolunna yaawailanaaa innnaa kunnaa zaalimeen

47.t: We will set up the scales of justice on the Day of Judgment, so no soul will be wronged in the least. And ˹even˺ if a deed is the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as a ˹vigilant˺ Reckoner
47.tr: Wa-nada'ul mawaazeenal qista li-Yawmil Qiyaamati falaa tuzlamu nafsun shai'aa; Wa-in kaana misqaala habbatim min khardalin atainaa bihaa; Wa-kafaa binaa haasibeen

48.t: Indeed, We granted Moses and Aaron the standard ˹to distinguish between right and wrong˺—a light and a reminder for the righteous
48.tr: Wa-laqad aatainaa Moosa Wa-haaroonal Furqaana Wa-diyaa'anw Wa-zikral lilmuttaqeen

49.t: who are in awe of their Lord without seeing Him, and are fearful of the Hour
49.tr: Allazeena yakhshawna Rabbahum bilghaibi Wa-hum minas Saa'ati mushfiqoon

50.t: And this ˹Quran˺ is a blessed reminder which We have revealed. Will you ˹pagans˺ then deny it
50.tr: Wa-haazaa Zikrum Mubaarakun anzalnaah; afa-antum lahoo munkiroon

51.t: And indeed, We had granted Abraham sound judgment early on, for We knew him well ˹to be worthy of it˺
51.tr: Wa-laqad aatainaaa Ibraaheema rushdahoo min qablu Wa-kunnaa bihee 'aalimeen

52.t: ˹Remember˺ when he questioned his father and his people, “What are these statues to which you are so devoted?”
52.tr: Iz qaala li-abeehi Wa-qawmihee maa haazihit tamaaseelul lateee antum lahaa 'aakifoon

53.t: They replied, “We found our forefathers worshipping them.”

54.t: He responded, “Indeed, you and your forefathers have been clearly astray.”
54.tr: Qaala laqad kuntum antum Wa-aabaaa'ukum fee dalaalin mubeen

55.t: They asked, “Have you come to us with the truth, or is this a joke?”
55.tr: Qaalooo aji'tanaa bil-haqqi am anta minal laa'ibeen

56.t: He replied, “In fact, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them ˹both˺. And to that I bear witness.”
56.tr: Qaala bar Rabbukum Rabbus samaawaati wal-ardil lazee fatarahunna Wa-ana 'alaa zaalikum minash shaahideen

57.t: ˹Then he said to himself,˺ “By Allah! I will surely plot against your idols after you have turned your backs and gone away.”
57.tr: Wa-tallaahi la-akeedanna asnaamakum ba'da an tuwalloo mudbireen

58.t: So he smashed them into pieces, except the biggest of them, so they might turn to it ˹for answers˺
58.tr: Faja'alahum juzaazan illaa kabeeral lahum la'allahum ilaihi yarji'oon

59.t: They protested, “Who dared do this to our gods? It must be an evildoer!”
59.tr: Qaaloo man fa'ala haazaa bi-aalihatinaaa innahoo laminaz zaalimeen

60.t: Some said, “We heard a young man, called Abraham, speaking ˹ill˺ of them.”
60.tr: Qaaloo sami'naa fatany yazkuruhum yuqaalu lahooo ibraaheem

61.t: They demanded, “Bring him before the eyes of the people, so that they may witness ˹his trial˺.”
61.tr: Qaaloo fa'too bihee 'alaaa a'yunin naasi la'allahum yash-hadoon

62.t: They asked, “Was it you who did this to our gods, O Abraham?”

63.t: He replied ˹sarcastically˺, “No, this one—the biggest of them—did it! So ask them, if they can talk!”
63.tr: Qaala bal fa'alahoo kabeeruhum haazaa fas'aloohum in kaanoo yantiqoon

64.t: So they came back to their senses, saying ˹to one another˺, “You yourselves are truly the wrongdoers!”
64.tr: Faraja'ooo ilaaa anfusihim faqaalooo innakum antumuz zaalimoon

65.t: Then they ˹quickly˺ regressed to their ˹original˺ mind-set, ˹arguing,˺ “You already know that those ˹idols˺ cannot talk.”
65.tr: Summa nukisoo 'alaa ru'oosihim laqad 'alimta maa haaa'ulaaa'i yantiqoon

66.t: He rebuked ˹them˺, “Do you then worship—instead of Allah—what can neither benefit nor harm you in any way
66.tr: Qaala afata'budoona min doonil laahi maa laa yanfa'ukum shai'anw Wa-laa yadurrukum

67.t: Shame on you and whatever you worship instead of Allah! Do you not have any sense?”
67.tr: Uffil lakum Wa-limaa ta'budoona min doonil laah; afalaa ta'qiloon

68.t: They concluded, “Burn him up to avenge your gods, if you must act.”
68.tr: Qaaloo harriqoohu wansurooo aalihatakum in kuntum faa'ileen

69.t: We ordered, “O fire! Be cool and safe for Abraham!”
69.tr: Qulnaa yaa-naaru koonee bardanw Wa-salaaman 'alaaa Ibraaheem

70.t: They had sought to harm him, but We made them the worst losers

71.t: Then We delivered him, along with Lot, to the land We had showered with blessings for all people
71.tr: Wa-najjainaahu Wa-Lootan ilal ardil latee baaraknaa feehaa lil-'aalameen

72.t: And We blessed him with Isaac ˹as a son˺ and Jacob ˹as a grandson˺, as an additional favour—making all of them righteous
72.tr: Wa-wahabnaa lahooo Ishaaqa; Wa-Ya'qooba naafilah; Wa-kullan ja'alnaa saaliheen

73.t: We ˹also˺ made them leaders, guiding by Our command, and inspired them to do good deeds, establish prayer, and pay alms-tax. And they were devoted to Our worship
73.tr: Wa-ja'alnaahum a'immataien yahdoona bi-amrinaa Wa-awhainaaa ilaihim fi'lal khairaati Wa-iqaamas Salaati Wa-eetaaa'az Zakaati Wa-kaanoo lanaa 'aabideen

74.t: And to Lot We gave wisdom and knowledge, and delivered him from the society engrossed in shameful practices. They were certainly an evil, rebellious people
74.tr: Wa-Lootan aatainaahu hukmanw Wa-'ilmanw Wa-najjainaahu minal qaryatil latee kaanat ta'malul khabaaa'is; innahum kaanoo qawma saw'in faasiqeen

75.t: And We admitted him into Our mercy, ˹for˺ he was truly one of the righteous
75.tr: Wa-adkhalnaahu fee rahmatinaa innahoo minas saaliheen

76.t: And ˹remember˺ when Noah had cried out to Us earlier, so We responded to him and delivered him and his family from the great distress
76.tr: Wa-noohan iz naadaa min qablu fastajabnaa lahoo fanajjainaahu Wa-ahlahoo minal karbil 'azeem

77.t: And We made him prevail over those who had rejected Our signs. They were truly an evil people, so We drowned them all
77.tr: Wa-nasarnaahu minal qawmil lazeena kazzaboo bi-Aayaatinaa; innahum kaanoo qawma saw'in fa-aghraq-naahum ajma'een

78.t: And ˹remember˺ when David and Solomon passed judgment regarding the crops ruined ˹at night˺ by someone’s sheep, and We were witness to their judgments
78.tr: Wa-Daawooda Wa-Sulaimaana iz yahkumaani fil harsi iz nafashat feehi ghanamul qawmi Wa-kunnaa lihukmihim shaahideen

79.t: We guided ˹young˺ Solomon to a fairer settlement, and granted each of them wisdom and knowledge. We subjected the mountains as well as the birds to hymn ˹Our praises˺ along with David. It is We Who did ˹it all˺
79.tr: Fafahhamnaahaa sulaimaan; Wa-kullan aatainaa hukmanw wa'ilmanw Wa-sakh-kharnaa ma'a Daawoodal jibaala yusabbihna wattayr; Wa-kunnaa faa'ileen

80.t: We taught him the art of making body armour to protect you in battle. Will you then be grateful
80.tr: Wa-'allamanaahu san'ata laboosil lakum lituhsinakum min ba'sikum fahal antum shaakiroon

81.t: And to Solomon We subjected the raging winds, blowing by his command to the land We had showered with blessings. It is We Who know everything
81.tr: Wa-li-Sulaimaanar reeha 'aasifatan tajree bi-amriheee ilal ardil latee baaraknaa feehaa; Wa-kunnaa bikulli shai'in 'aalimeen

82.t: And ˹We subjected˺ some jinn that dived for him, and performed other duties. It is We Who kept them in check
82.tr: Wa-minash Shayaateeni maien yaghoosoona lahoo Wa-ya'maloona 'amalan doona zaalika Wa-kunna lahum haafizeen

83.t: And ˹remember˺ when Job cried out to his Lord, “I have been touched with adversity, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.”
83.tr: Wa-Ayyooba iz naadaa Rabbahooo annee massaniyad durru Wa-Anta arhamur raahimeen

84.t: So We answered his prayer and removed his adversity, and gave him back his family, twice as many, as a mercy from Us and a lesson for the ˹devoted˺ worshippers
84.tr: Fastajabnaa lahoo fakashaf-naa maa bihee min durrinw Wa-aatainaahu ahlahoo Wa-mislahum ma'ahum rahmatan min 'indinaa Wa-zikraa lil'aabideen

85.t: And ˹remember˺ Ishmael, Enoch, and Ⱬul-Kifl. They were all steadfast
85.tr: Wa-Ismaa'eela Wa-Idreesa Wa-Zal Kifli kullum minas saabireen

86.t: We admitted them into Our mercy, for they were truly of the righteous
86.tr: Wa-adkhalnaahum fee rahmatinaa innahum minas saaliheen

87.t: And ˹remember˺ when the Man of the Whale stormed off ˹from his city˺ in a rage, thinking We would not restrain him. Then in the ˹veils of˺ darkness he cried out, “There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except You. Glory be to You! I have certainly done wrong.”
87.tr: Wa-Zan Nooni iz zahaba mughaadiban fa-zannaa al lan naqdira 'alaihi fanaadaa fiz zulumaati al laaa ilaaha illaaa Anta Subhaanaka innee kuntu minaz zaalimeen

88.t: So We answered his prayer and rescued him from anguish. And so do We save the ˹true˺ believers
88.tr: Fastajabnaa lahoo Wa-najjainaahu minal ghamm; Wa-kazaalika nunjil mu'mineen

89.t: And ˹remember˺ when Zachariah cried out to his Lord, “My Lord! Do not leave me childless, though You are the Best of Successors.”
89.tr: Wa-Zakariyyaaa iz naadaa Rabbahoo Rabbi laa tazarnee fardanw Wa-Anta khairul waariseen

90.t: So We answered his prayer, granted him John, and made his wife fertile. Indeed, they used to race in doing good, and call upon Us with hope and fear, totally humbling themselves before Us
90.tr: Fastajabnaa lahoo Wa-wahabnaa lahoo Yahyaa Wa-aslahnaa lahoo zawjah; innahum kaanoo yusaari'oona fil khairaati Wa-yad'oonanaa raghabanw Wa-rahabaa; Wa-kaanoo lanaa khaashi'een

91.t: And ˹remember˺ the one who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her through Our angel, ˹Gabriel,˺ making her and her son a sign for all peoples
91.tr: Wallateee ahsanat farjahaa fanafakhnaa feehaa min roohinaa Wa-ja'alnaahaa wabnahaaa Aayatan lil'aalameen

92.t: ˹O prophets!˺ Indeed, this religion of yours is ˹only˺ one, and I am your Lord, so worship Me ˹alone˺
92.tr: Inna haaziheee ummatukum ummatanw waahidatanw Wa-Ana Rabbukum fa'budoon

93.t: Yet the people have divided it into sects. But to Us they will all return
93.tr: Wa-taqatta'ooo amrahum bainahum kullun ilainaaa raaji'oon

94.t: So whoever does good and is a believer will never be denied ˹the reward for˺ their striving, for We are recording it all
94.tr: Famaien ya'mal minas saalihaati Wa-huwa mu'minun falaa kufraana lisa'yihee Wa-innaa lahoo kaatiboon

95.t: It is impossible for a society which We have destroyed to ever rise again
95.tr: Wa-haraamun 'alaa qaryatin ahlaknaahaaa annahum laa yarji'oon

96.t: until ˹after˺ Gog and Magog have broken loose ˹from the barrier˺, swarming down from every hill
96.tr: Hattaaa izaa futihat Ya'jooju Wa-Ma'jooju Wa-hum min kulli hadabien yansiloon

97.t: ushering in the True Promise. Then—behold!—the disbelievers will stare ˹in horror, crying,˺ “Oh, woe to us! We have truly been heedless of this. In fact, we have been wrongdoers.”
97.tr: Waqtarabal wa'dul haqqu fa-izaa hiya shaakhisatun absaarul lazeena kafaroo yaawailanaa qad kunna fee ghaflatin min haaza bal kunnaa zaalimeen

98.t: Certainly you ˹disbelievers˺ and whatever you worship instead of Allah will be the fuel of Hell. You are ˹all˺ bound to enter it
98.tr: Innakum Wa-maa ta'budoona min doonil laahi hasabu Jahannama antum lahaa waaridoon

99.t: Had those idols been ˹true˺ gods, they would not have entered it. And they will be there forever
99.tr: Law kaana haaa'ulaaa'i aalihatan maa waradoohaa Wa-kullun feehaa khaalidoon

100.t: In it they will groan, and will not be able to hear
100.tr: Lahum feehaa zafeerunw Wa-hum feehaa laa yasma'oon

101.t: Surely those for whom We have destined the finest reward will be kept far away from Hell
101.tr: Innal lazeena sabaqat lahum minnal husnaaa ulaaa'ika 'anhaa mub'adoon

102.t: not even hearing the slightest hissing from it. And they will delight forever in what their souls desire
102.tr: Laa yasma'oona hasee-sahaa Wa-hum fee mash tahat anfusuhum khaalidoon

103.t: The Supreme Horror ˹of that Day˺ will not disturb them, and the angels will greet them, ˹saying,˺ “This is your Day, which you have been promised.”
103.tr: Laa yahzunuhumul faza'ul akbaru Wa-tatalaq-qaahumul malaaa'ikatu haazaa Yawmukumul lazee kuntum too'adoon

104.t: On that Day We will roll up the heavens like a scroll of writings. Just as We produced the first creation, ˹so˺ shall We reproduce it. That is a promise binding on Us. We truly uphold ˹Our promises˺
104.tr: Yawma natwis samaaa'a kataiyis sijilli lilkutub; kamaa bada'naa awwala khalqin nu'eeduh; wa'dan 'alainaa; innaa kunna faa'ileen

105.t: Surely, following the ˹heavenly˺ Record, We decreed in the Scriptures: “My righteous servants shall inherit the land.”
105.tr: Wa-laqad katabnaa fiz Zaboori min ba'diz zikri annal arda yarisuhaa 'ibaadi-yas saalihoon

106.t: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is sufficient ˹as a reminder˺ for those devoted to worship

107.t: We have sent you ˹O Prophet˺ only as a mercy for the whole world

108.t: Say, “What has been revealed to me is this: ‘Your God is only One God.’ Will you then submit?”
108.tr: Qul innamaa yoohaa ilaiya annamaaa ilaahukum illaahunw Waahid, fahal antum muslimoon

109.t: If they turn away, then say, “I have warned you all equally. I do not know if what you are threatened with is near or far
109.tr: Fa-in tawallaw faqul aazantukum 'alaa sawaaa'; Wa-in adreee aqareebun am ba'eedun maa too'adoon

110.t: Allah surely knows what you say openly and whatever you hide
110.tr: Innahoo ya'lamul jahra minal qawli Wa-ya'lamu maa taktumoon

111.t: I do not know if this ˹delay˺ is possibly a test for you and an enjoyment for a while.”
111.tr: Wa-in adree la'allahoo fitnatul lakum Wa-mataa'un ilaa heen

112.t: ˹In the end,˺ the Prophet said, “My Lord! Judge ˹between us˺ in truth. And our Lord is the Most Compassionate, Whose help is sought against what you claim.”
112.tr: Qaala Rabbih kum bil-haqq; Wa-Rabbunar Rahmaa-nul musta'aanu 'alaa maa tasifoon
